subject: Temporary hold on LLM pilot — Q4 platform upgrade at NovaPlus
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Johnson <alexa.johnson@novaplus.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling — Redwood Inference demo (proposed 10/07)

Hi Alexa — thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. Per our discussion I've tentatively booked a 45-minute demo for Wednesday, Oct 7 at 10:00 AM PT. Agenda attached (redwood_demo_agenda.pdf).

Quick notes:
- We'll walk through a focused 20-minute live demo showing latency/throughput for a customer-like workload, then 15 minutes on routing/cost controls and a short Q&A.
- Rishi will cover deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

If that slot doesn't work, tell me a couple windows and we'll adjust. Otherwise, you should see the invite shortly.

Cheers,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachment: redwood_demo_agenda.pdf

From: Alexa Johnson <alexa.johnson@novaplus.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Park <amanda.park@novaplus.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling — Redwood Inference demo (proposed 10/07)

Hi Soojin — thanks for the agenda and for booking the time. Unfortunately, an internal roadmap decision came through late yesterday: our infra team is moving forward with a platform upgrade this quarter and leadership has asked product to pause new pilot work that requires cross-team integration.

We need to put the LLM pilot/demo on hold while we complete the Q4 platform migration. I know this is disappointing — it's not a reflection on Redwood, rather an internal resource reallocation.

Can we pause the demo for now and circle back in early January? If it's helpful, I'm attaching a short Q4 roadmap snapshot so you can see the timing (novaplus_q4_roadmap.pdf).

We'd still like a one-pager and any short case studies we can share internally when we kick this back up. Please keep us on your nurture list and check in after the holidays.

Appreciate your flexibility,
Alexa Johnson
Product Lead, Integrations | NovaPlus
alexa.johnson@novaplus.com
Attachment: novaplus_q4_roadmap.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Johnson <alexa.johnson@novaplus.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling — Redwood Inference demo (proposed 10/07)

Hi Alexa — thanks for the note and for sharing the roadmap. Completely understand — platform migrations are a heavy lift.

We can absolutely pause the scheduled demo. Proposed plan:
- Hold the existing invite but mark "tentative" and remove any internal calendar reminders so it doesn't clutter your teams.
- I'll send a concise one-pager and a short NovaPlus-relevant case study (redwood_one_pager.pdf, novaplus_case_study.pdf) by tomorrow for your internal review.
- We'll set a tentative follow-up week of Jan 11–15 to reconnect. If you prefer a specific date, tell me and I'll pencil it in tentatively.

In the meantime, if there's a preferred internal stakeholder you want us to share collateral with (security/compliance or infra owners), point me to them and we'll tailor the materials.

If OK, I'd like to keep the HubSpot opportunity open at a "nurture" stage so we can track timing and set a reminder to re-engage.

Thanks — we'll be flexible on cadence.

Best,
Soojin

---
Attachment: redwood_one_pager.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: NovaPlus — demo hold / nurture plan

Looping in a quick internal note:
- Good call pausing. Let's move this opportunity to Nurture in HubSpot and set a task to re-open Jan 11.
- Offer idea: send a free 30-day trial credit (small) and the one-pager + case study to keep engagement warm. Rishi, can you draft a short credit offer line?
- Neha, please add a reminder to the Q1 re-engage board and file the novaplus_q4_roadmap.pdf under the account folder.

Soojin — ping if they indicate any compliance/questions we should pre-empt.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Alexa Johnson <alexa.johnson@novaplus.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Park <amanda.park@novaplus.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling — Redwood Inference demo (proposed 10/07)

Thanks, Soojin and team — that plan works for us. Please go ahead and move the invite to tentative and send the one-pager/case study. Reconnect with me the week of Jan 11; Jan 12 or 13 are likely good windows.

We appreciate the flexibility. A quick ask: include a bullet in the one-pager about how Redwood handles private deployments and audit logs — our security stakeholders will want that high level.

I'll expect the materials and will look for the follow-up in January.

Best,
Alexa

Attachment: novaplus_case_study.pdf
snippet: Prospect requests a temporary hold on the demo due to a Q4 platform upgrade; team to nurture and re-engage in Jan.
